# Christian Bloch Thomsen - Freelance Frontend Senior Developer

Christian Bloch Thomsen is a freelance senior frontend developer and consultant based in Aarhus, Denmark.

He has 25+ years of frontend development experience and 15+ years of consulting experience across public-facing websites, complex internal business applications, frontend architecture, and development workflows.
